SELECT p.Diagnosis
FROM main.Patient AS p
WHERE p."First Date" >= '1998-02-15'
  AND p."First Date" < '1998-03-01'
  AND p.Admission LIKE '+%'
  AND p.Birthday IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY julianday(p."First Date") - julianday(p.Birthday) DESC, p.ID ASC
LIMIT 1
